summary: Remote WebSocket server can spawn and drive an interactive shell/PTY on the installer's host
details: The package connects to a configurable WebSocket server (SERVER_URL, default ws://localhost:3456 but documented for remote wss:// endpoints) and routes inbound messages to privileged local operations. message-router.js dispatches 'terminal_create' and 'terminal_input' to handlers in terminal.js: handleTerminalCreate calls pty.spawn on the system shell (bash/pwsh/cmd) in a working directory, and handleTerminalInput writes network-supplied msg.data directly into that PTY, giving whoever controls the WebSocket server arbitrary shell execution as the invoking user. The same router additionally exposes remote file read/write/delete/move, git operations, LLM/MCP config mutation, process restart, and a self-upgrade (upgrade_agent) that reinstalls @yeaft/webchat-agent@latest from https://pkg.yeaft.com/. index.js also fires environment mutation on load: it runs npm install in the package directory when node_modules is missing, git-clones https://github.com/yeaft/yeaft-skills.git into ~/.claude/plugins, chmods hook scripts 0755, and writes ~/.claude/settings.json — these run on require()/import as well as via the CLI.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
